lessons.title: The Nature of Scientific Thinking in Psychology
lessons.description: Understand empiricism, the demarcation problem, why intuition fails, and Popper's falsifiability criterion.

lessons.title: From Theories to Hypotheses: The Scientific Cycle
lessons.description: Explore how psychologists formulate broad theories, deduce testable hypotheses, and apply the principle of parsimony.

lessons.title: Operational Definitions: Measuring the Invisible
lessons.description: Transform unobservable psychological constructs like anxiety, love, and intelligence into concrete, measurable indicators.

lessons.title: The Four Core Goals of Psychological Science
lessons.description: Examine the sequential scientific hierarchy: description, prediction, causal explanation, and applied behavioral change.
